expectations.name: component-header-and-member-tsdoc
expected_behavior: Adds `wide` to `AppLayout.vue`'s header block in backticks, saying what it changes (the content area drops its maximum width), and adds no TSDoc to the `wide` member of the `defineProps` type
Deletes the TSDoc on the `title` member of the `defineProps` type, keeping `title` named in the header block
Leaves the rest of the header block's wording and the script's other comments unchanged (rewrapping the block around the new sentence is allowed), and changes no code
Reports the two changes as `file:Symbol — 5: …` (the incomplete header) and `file:Symbol — 6: …` (the member TSDoc), and a Verify line naming Biome, vue-tsc, and the width measure as passed

expectations.name: file-target-plan-and-facts
expected_behavior: Presents a plan listing the items whose checklist items fire, and writes nothing before `go`
Adds to `device`'s TSDoc that it returns null when the server has no device of that ID
Leaves the TSDoc of `devices`, `ApiError`, `readError`, and the module header unchanged
Changes no code in `api.ts`, and Verify passes

expectations.name: pages-directory-stale-and-restating
expected_behavior: Corrects `SitesPage.vue`'s header from "by city" to by name, matching the sort in the code
Leaves the inline comment `// Delete the key when the value is empty.` in `DevicesPage.vue` untouched, because `only=tsdoc` skips inline comments
Changes no code in any page, and Verify passes
